**326**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B). Invoked
`live_verification=false` — committed exporter/resolution/web code and
fixture + testcontainer verification only. **This row performs no
hosted mutation, no live legs and no publication:** dedup is an
announce criterion and its public effect rides P35.63's HG-11 Class-S
publish leg verbatim (D-K13-4 [B-26], applied not re-decided). No gate

Cited: SIG-CONF-004 (owner P35.46 — the links this row publishes),

P35.48), ADR-116/ADR-R9-HUMANER (recorded human-accepted edges list

(PR #345, head `434cea82`, 5/5 green at dispatch). **Gate:** none —
the publish rides P35.63.

## The problem

P35.46 recorded derivation-collapse (`derived_from` + shared `site_id`,
C0/C1/C2 basis) and possible-duplicate links in the spine, but the
export never read them: published site rows stayed one row per
observation-level record, every published count was a silent point
value, and the ER output fed only the national "N resolved sites"
figure — F-511's measured inflation. The public record carried no
`site_id`, no copy list, no possible-duplicate list, and no interval.

## What landed

- **`exports/dedup.py`** (new) — `build_dedup_view` assembles ONE shared
  `DedupView` over the latest completed camera-site ER run and the
  export's own coordinate-record members: `site_members` (cluster →
  members), `canonical` (one emitted record per post-collapse site),
  per-record `site_id` / `copies[]` / `possible_duplicates[]` /
  `multi_view[]` / `n_independent_lineages`, the applied/possible edge
  sets, the declared threshold distance, and `lineage_not_evaluable`
  honesty. `interval_block` calls the dep's own
  `resolution.camera_sites.count_bounds` verbatim (upper = applied
  edges only; lower additionally folds possible duplicates within the
  declared distance; endpoints restricted to the requested member
  subset) and emits the L3 §5.2 display verbatim — *"412 camera
  records · between 371 and 398 listed cameras ([why a
  range?](/quality/#duplicates))"*. `dossier_inflation` measures
  published rows vs lineage roots beside the ≤ 1.02 ratchet target.
  Every display string is the contracted wording: copies *"…(a copy of
  the same upstream record, id <id>, checked automatically)"*;
  possible duplicates *"Possible duplicate: <Source> lists a camera <d>
  m away. SIG has not merged them because it cannot prove they are the
  same device."*; multi-view names the records separate views, never
  duplicates. Honest absence is `[]` for measured empties,
  `not_recorded` for no completed run, `not_evaluable` for missing
  lineage inputs — never a fabricated zero.
- **`resolution/camera_sites.py` + `camera_sites_pg.py`** —
  `count_bounds` extracted as the single interval-bound implementation
  (`count_intervals` now delegates); `read_resolved_site_runs` widened
  to return the full recorded link set — applied auto-write +
  human-accepted edges, proposed, cannot-link and refused links with
  `left`/`right`/disposition/relation/tier/`site_id` and the complete
  `_link_stamp` evidence (`link_kind`, `basis`, `shared_upstream_ref`,
  `lineage_ids`, `distance_m`, possible-duplicate reason).
- **`spine_export.py`** — the emit shape is one row per post-collapse
  record (GQ-10 verbatim: "published site rows = records after
  derivation-collapse"): `_slice_sites` emits the canonical member per
  site and stamps every row's dedup fields; non-canonical members nest
  under `copies[]` keeping their claim anchors (`slices.nested_members`
  feeds `_claim_slots`, so a copy's own claims still file in its own
  licence compartment); a licence-refused canonical yields to the next
  emitted member, and an all-refused site emits no row — the honest
  refusal posture. Every new field is registered in `_sites_specs`
  (P35.39 column registry; `assert_documented` passes). The resolved-
  sites coverage metric + `web/map.json` publish the interval
  (`count_interval` beside the layer description); map point assets
  draw only canonical members and carry `site_id` +
  `n_independent_lineages`; a collapsed copy never paints a second
  point.
- **`dossier_sources.py`** — `totals.count_interval` +
  `totals.dossier_inflation_vs_lineage_roots` (published_rows,
  lineage_roots, measured, target) per dossier, mirrored into the
  keyed `sig.dossier/1` docs' `rollup.count_interval` /
  `rollup.dossier_inflation_vs_lineage_roots`; the `listed_cameras`
  figure carries the interval + verbatim display + pointer — one
  computation, never two.
- **`published_record.py`** — `PublishedRecord.dedup` (sparse): the
  id-free content document gains `dedup` only when present, so
  pre-P35.47 records stay byte-identical; the release record pages
  project the site row's fields.
- **`<comp>/count_interval.json`** (`sig.count-interval/1`) — the
  bulk-files leg: each licence compartment whose sites table carries
  members gets the member-record count beside `[lower, upper]`.
- **`ops/quality.py`** — `eval_gq10` file evaluator: published row
  count vs lineage-root upper bound, measured inflation ratio,
  possible-duplicate coverage (every ≥ 2-lineage member within the
  declared distance is collapsed or listed), interval presence,
  multi-view classification, explicit absence when no evaluable run
  exists — measured and surfaced, never smoothed; removed from
  `SEAM_DEFERRALS`.
- **`web/`** — `dossier.ts` `rollup.count_interval` type +
  `dossier-figures.ts` `listed_cameras` spec (`/rollup/count_interval/
  display`, allow-listed in the root-absolute-path baseline as a JSON
  pointer, never a link) renders the interval figure on dossier pages
  when the artifact carries it — no new JS, content pages stay T0/T1
  zero-script.

## Verification

- `uv run pytest tests/exports/test_dedup_publish.py

  never a duplicate, lineage counts, `not_recorded`/`not_evaluable`
  honesty, interval bounds from the dep's computation, measured
  inflation, licence-refused canonical never leaking, one-row-per-
  record export shape, map canonical-only points + interval, dossier
  totals/figure parity, nested claim anchors, record projection, and
  the four GQ-10 evaluator paths (pass / inflation-over-target /
  uncovered pair / no-run absence).
- `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/db` — green including
  `test_camera_site_materialize.py` (the real sqitch path: materialize
  → `read_resolved_site_runs` → export emits the interval wording —
  the point "N resolved sites" wording is withdrawn in favour of the
  range per the design's own note, and the test now asserts the
  contracted display + `count_interval` block).
- `make check` — lint/format/mypy (383 files) clean; suite **10,120
  passed**, 4 failures verified unrelated/environmental:
  `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` unset locally (fail-closed by design, passes with
  the env armed; CI arms it via `vars`) and `test_p34_18_aliases` ×2

- `npm --prefix web run check` — green: typecheck (198 files, 0

  allow-list entry), figure-pointer check, 332 e2e tests.
